These interact as a feedback loop—each primitive's output feeds into the next. Trust gate validation ensures vocabulary integrity; negative tests validate that forbidden content is rejected; policy edits adjust system behavior. Failure modes include vocabulary drift, false negatives in negative tests, and inconsistent session behavior. The system's robustness depends on closed-loop monitoring of these interactions.
